header.description: DBM: a plain swap through a gate featurizer computes sigma(theta)*x_src + (1-sigma(theta))*x_base; theta trained under L1 with a temperature anneal. Gate width derived from (model, site); note anneal's value IS a list (start, end, frac) - list-typed fields are never sweep axes. WARNING, unresolved: at l1=0.01 against ce=1.0 the gate need not separate. The shipped run of this document (results/protocols/dbm.json) records decisive_fraction 0.0, no dimension outside [0.1, 0.9], and a fit can still score 1.000 at a readout layer - because Gate._mask is a HARD theta>0 mask in eval mode, so an unseparated theta makes the mask a coin flip on gradient noise and about half the dimensions swap, which at the readout layer scores 1.000. Read fit_diagnostics.json before believing a DBM number: decisive_fraction near 0 means the gate never committed and the score describes noise. Retuning l1/anneal so theta separates needs a GPU run to validate and has not been done, so these values are inherited defaults, not endorsed ones. That unresolved tuning is also why `train` stays in THIS file and is not factored into a block shared with another method family: l1, anneal and the 20-epoch budget are this family's, and a shared block would hand another family these numbers. `train.eval.split` is left open - the eval POLICY is the method's, the held-out dataset is the application's.
